Class Booking

java.lang.Object
com.atu.WednesdaysWickedAdventures.model.Booking
public class Booking extends Object
Represents a BOOKING entity in the Wednesdays Wicked Adventures system. This class is mapped to the "bookings" collection in MongoDB.
